That could be "故意伤害" (intentional injury) and "非法拘禁" (illegal detention) or "抢劫"? No theft. They didn't take property. They maybe "强行抢劫"? Not described. They just forced him into car, maybe "强迫他人乘坐交通工具" not a crime. Also "故意伤害罪" because they used brick causing injury. Also "寻衅滋事"? Could be but not needed. The facts show they used violence, causing injury, and then left. So list: 故意伤害;非法拘禁.

Check if "抢劫" requires theft of property. Not present. "敲诈勒索"? No. "强奸"? No. So answer.

Need format: [故意伤害;非法拘禁]<eoa>
